vote.description: One vote of a quorum decision: a listed role's answer from its vote task, or the asking role's recommendation when the declaration lists it (asker true, without a task).

queue_task_id.description: The vote task; null for the asking role's vote.

task_outcome.description: The vote task's outcome; null for the asking role's vote.

branch_key.description: The chosen option; null for a vote task without a valid answer.

kind.description: A decider kind (<<decider-kind>>), every kind but fact. operator: on a decided line the operator's answer to a decision (channel, answer); on a corrected line of cause overridden the waiver that overrode the gate (waiver_id), never a decider of its own.

rule.description: server_rule: the deciding primitive or rule id (model-work/11, Decision Points).

votes.description: quorum only: every vote of the question's quorum declaration.

channel.description: operator answer only: the channel of the answer (store-schemas/14, Answers from the Terminal Client).

device_id.description: operator answer only, channel web: the paired device.

answer.description: operator answer only: how the operator answered (store-schemas/14, Question Record, answer.kind).

after_chat.description: operator answer only: the answer followed a chat in the decision.

waiver_id.description: corrected line of cause overridden only.

decision_id.description: decided: the new decision; corrected: the decision corrected.

declaration_digest.description: question.adjudicate only: the declaration digest (model-work/10, Quorum Calibration) of the quorum declaration applied; null where none applied (kind_ask).

decision_point.description: decided only: one of the closed decision points (model-work/11, Decision Points), for example outline.classify-change-type, remediation.choose, triage.group, decision.interpret, question.adjudicate, question.answer.

state_id.description: decided only: the state that took the decision.

ref.description: question_id, the group key (domain, rule_id) with its firing, the trigger kind with its evidence key, the policy with its call state, a plan task id; null for plan and scope.

decider.description: decided: the decider; corrected: who caused the correction.

facts_digest.description: The facts snapshot of a judgment decision (Facts Snapshot); null for a server rule.

options.description: decided only: the closed set chosen from; null for a question decision (the question record owns the options) and for a rule that measures without a closed set.

measurements.description: decided only: every measured value with the threshold applied.

name.description: For example overlap_paths, conflicted_files, vote_confidence, agreeing_votes, aggregated_confidence, light_budget_total.

source.description: null when no threshold applies; unit: a declaration of the project-owned unit that took the decision.

key.description: The constant, the unit declaration as <unit_id>.<name>, the configuration key, or the waiver_id the threshold came from.

unit_digest.description: source unit: the SHA-256 of the unit file whose declaration applied (the digest the plan instance binds); null otherwise.

choice.description: decided: the option taken, null when the decision hands the choice on; corrected: the new choice, null for the causes overridden and replanned.

follows.description: decided only: the decision this one completes.

ref.description: corrected only: what caused the correction: a decision_id, a replan_id, a waiver_id, or the ratchet's escalation_trigger.
